body: I first heard Phil Madeira playing back-up for Phil Keaggy like thirty-five years ago. I loved Phil K, but I also thought, “That guy on the keyboards is a force to be reckoned with.” Then I heard Mercyland in 2012. We all give God the Blues seemed like it was written as a soundtrack for my 2012 release. Anyway – Phil’s got another project in the works, and I think we’ll all love it.
